# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.50 (pre-release)

Written and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; the automated tests pass on CI runners. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64.**

**New: article images (command line)**
- `--article-query TEXT --article-crops DIR` (with `--ocr`) writes one PNG for each newspaper or magazine article that contains the text, e.g. `Voyager`: the column of the hit is cut from its headline down to the next headline or gap. A headline stays with its text; short items in one column are told apart by their bold first words. Case and diacritics are ignored and a word broken with a hyphen at the end of a line is found.
- Tried on pages of Scânteia, August–September 1977 (five articles about the Voyager probes, one of them across three columns); the result was looked at by eye. **Limits**: an article that goes on in another column or on another page is cut at the column; a text OCR did not read is not found; other papers and magazines were not tried. Not in the window yet.

**Not verified**: Windows, macOS, arm64. On the macOS Intel runner (experimental) two PKCS#12 tests fail because of its OpenSSL, unrelated.
